debts.title: Debts & loans
debts.subtitle: What you owe and what is owed to you, loans included
debts.dueDateHint: Optional. When set, the planner charges it on that day.
debts.withInterestHint: A bank loan, a car loan, a credit line — anything where the balance grows.
debts.interestFreeHint: Payments at the start that carry no interest. The rate applies to what is left afterwards.
debts.rateTypeHint: A floating rate is an index — Euribor, or the ECB's — plus the bank's margin, re-read every few months. Most mortgages are one.
debts.rateWatchInterestMore: {{amount}} more in interest before it is paid off
debts.rateWatchInterestLess: {{amount}} less in interest before it is paid off
debts.rateWatchPrompt: Pick a move and see what the payment becomes.
debts.fieldAmountBody: What the bank handed over — the capital. {{amount}} in the example below.
debts.fieldIndexBody: The market rate the loan follows, Euribor or the ECB's. You type today's value and correct it at each reset. {{value}}% here.
debts.fieldMarginBody: The fixed slice the bank adds on top. Typed once, and it does not change until the loan is paid off. {{value}}% here.
debts.fieldTermBody: How many monthly payments it is repaid in. {{months}} months, which is {{years}} years.
debts.fieldFreeBody: How many of the first payments carry no interest. Leave it at 0 if there are none.
debts.fieldRateBody: The rate you agreed, the same for the whole term. Only a fixed loan has one.
debts.rateHelpPartsBody: An index plus a margin. The index — Euribor, or the ECB's own rate — belongs to the market and moves. The margin belongs to the bank and stays the same until the loan is paid off.
debts.rateHelpWhenBody: Every one, three or six months, whichever the contract says. At each reset the bank reads the index again and works the loan out afresh.
debts.rateHelpEffectBody: The payment, not the end date. The bank works out a new payment on what is still owed, over the months that are left — so the loan still finishes on the day it always would.
debts.rateHelpExampleIntro: {{amount}} over {{months}} payments at {{base}}% index + {{margin}}% margin. Then the index goes up one point.
debts.rateHelpYours: Your loan, and what one point on the index would do to it.
debts.rateHelpPunch: One point on the rate is not one percent on the payment — here it is {{percent}} more.
debts.rateHelpAppBody: Every figure on a floating loan comes from the rate in force today. When the reset comes, update the index and the rest follows.

accounts.stale_other: Last update {{count}} days ago — time for a new one?
accounts.undoConfirm: Remove the last update? The balance goes back to counting from the one before.
accounts.howItWorks: You type what each bank shows and what is in your wallet. The app compares it with everything written down since the last time, and the difference is what was spent or received without a record. Cash withdrawals and moves between your own accounts never need writing down. Money in Goals is taken to stay in these banks; money put into Investments is taken to have left them.
accounts.firstFinding: Before this, the app had you at {{said}} (goals included). Your banks differ from that by {{gap}}. From now on the balance counts from what you read.
accounts.findingClean: The update on {{date}} matched what you wrote down ✓
accounts.findingMissing: The update on {{date}} found {{amount}} spent without a record. If you remember what it was, add it with its date and this shrinks by itself.
accounts.findingExtra: The update on {{date}} found {{amount}} more than recorded — income not written down, or a refund?
accounts.readHint: Each box already holds what the app expects. Change only the ones that differ.
accounts.readHintFirst: Type what each one holds right now.
accounts.notWrittenHint: Kept as “without a record” and shown in the month’s figures. If you remember what it was, add it with its date and the gap shrinks.
accounts.cameUnwrittenHint: More than expected — perhaps income not written down, or a refund.
accounts.kindToggle: Tap to switch between bank and cash
accounts.name: Name
accounts.holdsNowHint: It joins without counting as money found — it was already yours.
accounts.mainHint: Between updates, what you write down is taken to come out of this one.
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from every past update too, as if it had never been listed.
accounts.setupHint: Add each bank and your cash, with what each holds right now. Tap the icon to switch between bank and cash.
accounts.movementsMainHint: Records without a card since the last update count here too.
accounts.editInReading: Before the last bank update, which stays as it was: the balance doesn’t move.
accounts.adjustReadingHint: Turn off only if that update’s balances came straight from the bank and were already right.
